rows.label: TALKS

rows.label: CALL

rows.label: GAME LAW

rows.label: DETAILS

rows.label: SQUELCH

rows.label: BYE

rows.label: EARMARK
rows.clue: Identification mark on the ear of a domestic animal

rows.label: AVOWAL
rows.clue: A statement asserting the existence or the truth of something

rows.label: LIBRETTO
rows.clue: The words of an opera or musical play

rows.label: SHOUTING
rows.clue: Encouragement in the form of cheers from spectators

rows.label: GLOSSY
rows.clue: A magazine printed on good quality paper

rows.label: REBUKE
rows.clue: An act or expression of criticism and censure

rows.label: PERSONAL
rows.clue: A short newspaper article about a particular person or group

rows.label: FILE
rows.clue: A set of related records (either written or electronic) kept together

rows.label: EPITHET
rows.clue: A defamatory or abusive word or phrase

rows.label: SLANDER
rows.clue: Words falsely spoken that damage the reputation of another

rows.label: POOR LAW
rows.clue: A law providing support for the poor

rows.label: NEWS SHOW
rows.clue: A program devoted to current events, often using interviews and commentary

rows.label: SPAR BUOY
rows.clue: A buoy resembling a vertical log

rows.label: CLUE
rows.clue: A slight indication

rows.label: APPENDIX
rows.clue: Supplementary material that is collected and appended at the back of a book

rows.label: LAUGHTER
rows.clue: The sound of laughing

rows.label: OPEN DOOR
rows.clue: The policy of granting equal trade opportunities to all countries

rows.label: LOVE SONG
rows.clue: A song about love or expressing love for another person

rows.label: PLOY
rows.clue: An opening remark intended to secure an advantage for the speaker

rows.label: HALL PASS
rows.clue: Written permission from a teacher for a student to be out the classroom and in the halls of the school

rows.label: LITANY
rows.clue: Any long and tedious address or recital

rows.label: NEWSCAST
rows.clue: A broadcast of news or commentary on the news

rows.label: TUNE
rows.clue: A succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence

rows.label: TATTLE
rows.clue: Disclosing information or giving evidence about another

rows.label: LAST WORD
rows.clue: The final statement in a verbal argument

rows.label: TEMPORAL
rows.clue: The semantic role of the noun phrase that designates the time of the state or action denoted by the verb

rows.label: HUDDLE
rows.clue: (informal) a quick private conference

rows.label: NONSENSE
rows.clue: A message that seems to convey no meaning

rows.label: TELEGRAM
rows.clue: A message transmitted by telegraph

rows.label: WEB PAGE
rows.clue: A document connected to the World Wide Web and viewable by anyone connected to the internet who has a web browser

rows.label: PREFACE
rows.clue: A short introductory essay preceding the text of a book

rows.label: VERB
rows.clue: The word class that serves as the predicate of a sentence

rows.label: BRAVADO
rows.clue: A swaggering show of courage

rows.label: CONVERSE
rows.clue: A proposition obtained by conversion

rows.label: WEB SITE
rows.clue: A computer connected to the internet that maintains a series of web pages on the World Wide Web

rows.label: HYBRID
rows.clue: A word that is composed of parts from different languages (e.g., `monolingual' has a Greek prefix and a Latin root)

rows.label: ARROW
rows.clue: A mark to indicate a direction or relation

rows.label: ANSWER
rows.clue: A statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation

rows.label: TERM
rows.clue: A word or expression used for some particular thing

rows.label: BOOK
rows.clue: A written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)

rows.label: BOO
rows.clue: A cry or noise made to express displeasure or contempt

rows.label: TRUE BILL
rows.clue: An indictment endorsed by a grand jury

rows.label: BETA
rows.clue: The 2nd letter of the Greek alphabet

rows.label: DRAWING
rows.clue: An illustration that is drawn by hand and published in a book, magazine, or newspaper

rows.label: MEDAL
rows.clue: An award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event

rows.label: WHISPER
rows.clue: Speaking softly without vibration of the vocal cords

rows.label: FIRE CODE
rows.clue: Set of standards established and enforced by government for fire prevention and safety in case of fire as in fire escapes etc
